description: Chief <-> Career Ops job-intelligence configuration (roster B13 Job Description Analyzer, B14 Company/Role Research Brief). The analyzer is DETERMINISTIC and extractive: every requirement, responsibility, keyword and eligibility condition it emits is a verbatim line of the posting text with its source line number. It never turns an employer preference into a fact, never invents a requirement the posting does not state, and never records a claim about the candidate. The research brief interface consumes cited evidence from an approved provider when one is available and otherwise records research_needed — it never guesses a company fact.

extraction.note: Section headings are matched deterministically. A line is emitted verbatim with its 1-based source line number and the section it came from; nothing is summarised, merged, reworded or added.

section_rules.label: responsibilities
section_rules.pattern: responsibilit|what you.?ll do|what you will do|the role|duties|day to day|day-to-day|about the role|your role|key tasks|main tasks

section_rules.label: requirements
section_rules.pattern: essential|requirements?|must have|must-have|qualification|what we.?re looking for|what we are looking for|who you are|skills? (and|&) experience|your profile

section_rules.label: about_company
section_rules.pattern: about us|about the company|who we are|our company|the company

preference_policy: Lines that the posting marks as desirable/preferred/nice-to-have are recorded with kind='desirable' and mirrored into 'preferences' with an explicit note. They are NEVER recorded as essential requirements and NEVER converted into a claim about what the candidate has.
eligibility_policy: Eligibility lines are recorded as the posting states them. A condition is marked 'satisfied_by_owner_source' only when a canonical owner source (config/profile.yml, cv.md) states it; otherwise it is 'unknown' and appears in risks_unknowns. The analyzer never assumes a visa, sponsorship, clearance or degree position the owner has not stated.
keyword_policy: Keywords are the posting's own vocabulary (tokens of length >= 3, minus a generic stop list). They are search/ranking aids only and are never treated as evidence that the candidate has the skill.

research.note: The research brief interface accepts evidence ONLY from an approved provider and only with a citation. When no provider is available it returns status='research_needed' and lists exactly what it wanted — it never writes a company fact it cannot cite.

file.note: Each fact must carry a source and a citation; facts without them are rejected and listed under rejected_facts.

http.reason: disabled by default: no owner-approved research endpoint is configured. Enable per-source only with an owner-approved endpoint list.

browser.reason: disabled: the owner's 2026-09-23 late-night directive forbids launching or controlling an interactive browser, Windows Search or another visible GUI application from this machine unless the immutable task explicitly requires that exact UI action.

requested_defaults: role-specific expectations not stated in the posting

not_performed: Any interactive browser, GUI application or Windows Search launch
Any employer, recruiter or candidate-facing message
Any claim about the candidate that is not present verbatim in a canonical source
